name: OpenBookQA: Question Answering on Open Book Science Exams
description: OpenBookQA is a question answering dataset modeled after open book exams for assessing human understanding of a subject. Composed of 5,957 4-choice multiple-choice science questions requiring an open book of 1,326 elementary science facts alongside common knowledge and multi-step reasoning.
